close_reason: Single-line doc fix landed at 726f258. Workspace audit confirmed no sibling *-server crates carried the same stale prescription; mail-server backend.rs:230 was the only occurrence workspace-wide. All gates green (cargo fmt / clippy -D warnings / test --workspace / RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings doc).
description:
crate-jmap-mail-server/src/backend.rs:230 — the import_email trait method's doc-comment error-mapping table prescribes:

    | `Err(BackendSetError::Other(e))` | `notCreated[creationId] = { type: "serverFail", description: <e.to_string()> }` |

This is the exact wire-leak pattern that bd:JMAP-jfia.1 closed for the BackendChangesError path: interpolating the backend's Display output into the wire `description` field can leak credentials, blob bytes, internal paths, or PII embedded in downstream errors (e.g. Postgres errors that include the offending row, S3 errors that include the bucket+key, Redis errors that include the connection URI with embedded auth, tracing-instrumented errors with span attributes).

The actual implementations in email.rs:1178, mailbox.rs:610, identity.rs:283, sieve.rs:433, submission.rs:483, etc. correctly use `server_fail_value_from_backend(&e)` — the helper from jmap-server::handlers that drops the Display string and substitutes SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC. So no live leak exists. But the trait-doc prescription is the canonical guidance future contributors will follow when adding new backend methods or new mail-server modules.

Fix: replace the table row at backend.rs:230 with:

    | `Err(BackendSetError::Other(e))` | `notCreated[creationId] = server_fail_value_from_backend(&e)` (description = "internal error", per bd:JMAP-wlip.2 / bd:JMAP-jfia.1 redaction contract) |

Audit every other `Err(BackendSetError::Other(e))` row in the trait docs in this crate:
- import_email (backend.rs:230)
- any other trait method's doc-table that prescribes the same pattern

Sweep the canonical-template propagation per workspace AGENTS.md: jmap-mail-server is the canonical extension-server template, so the same audit must run against jmap-chat-server, jmap-calendars-server, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-filenode-server, jmap-sharing-server, jmap-metadata-server backend.rs trait docs.

Discovered during /do-beads JMAP-jfia investigation of JMAP-jfia.36 (BackendSetError redaction contract). The .36 comment claimed mdn.rs:462-466 had a live leak; on inspection it does not (uses server_fail_from_backend correctly). The actual leak risk lives in the stale trait-doc prescription, not the implementations.

Priority P1 because the stale doc is the most likely path to introducing a future leak in mail-server or any sibling extension-server. Same severity class as bd:JMAP-jfia.1 (defence-in-depth gap, not live exploit).
notes: Discovered while investigating JMAP-jfia.36. See that bead's 2026-05-15 comment for the original (incorrect) leak claim and this bead's description for the corrected analysis.
title: jmap-mail-server backend.rs:230 trait doc prescribes BackendSetError::Other leak that the actual implementation correctly avoids
